data.question: Berapa persentase penduduk miskin di Nusa Tenggara Timur pada Maret 2025?

value.raw_question: Berapa persentase penduduk miskin di Nusa Tenggara Timur pada Maret 2025?

value.sql:
SELECT 
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah, 
    periode, 
    SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) / SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) * 100 AS persentase_penduduk_miskin
FROM 
    provinsi
JOIN 
    nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE 
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY 
    provinsi.nama, periode
ORDER BY 
    nilai DESC

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, periode, SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) * 100 / COUNT(nilai_indikator.kode_indikator) AS persentase
FROM nilai_indikator
JOIN provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.nama, periode
ORDER BY persentase DESC;

SELECT T1.nama AS wilayah, T2.periode, SUM(T3.nilai) * 100 / COUNT(T3.nilai) AS persentase_penduduk_miskin
FROM provinsi AS T1
JOIN nilai_indikator AS T3 ON T1.kode = T3.kode_provinsi
JOIN indikator AS T2 ON T3.kode_indikator = T2.kode
WHERE T2.kode_kanonik = 'penduduk_miskin' AND T3.periode = :periode AND T1.kode IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY T1.nama, T2.periode
ORDER BY T3.nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, 
       nilai_indikator.nilai AS nilai, 
       (SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) * 100 / COUNT(nilai_indikator.nilai)) AS persentase_penduduk_miskin
FROM provinsi
JOIN nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.nama, nilai_indikator.nilai;

SELECT
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    nilai_indikator.periode AS periode,
    ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN nilai_indikator.nilai <= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100) / COUNT(nilai_indikator.nilai), 2) AS persentase_penduduk_miskin
FROM
    nilai_indikator
JOIN
    provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY
    provinsi.nama,
    nilai_indikator.periode
ORDER BY
    nilai_indikator.nilai DESC;

value.sql:
SELECT
  provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
  periode,
  SUM(nilai) AS total_penduduk
FROM
  nilai_indikator
INNER JOIN
  provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE
  nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY
  periode, provinsi.nama
ORDER BY
  total_penduduk DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    periode,
    SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) * 100 / SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) OVER (PARTITION BY periode) AS persentase_miskin
FROM
    provinsi
JOIN
    nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY
    periode, provinsi.kode
ORDER BY
    periode, provinsi.kode;

SELECT T1.wilayah, T1.periode, SUM(T2.nilai) / COUNT(*) AS persentase_penduduk_miskin
FROM provinsi AS T1
JOIN nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
WHERE T2.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND T2.periode = :periode
AND T1.kode IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY T1.wilayah, T1.periode;
